entry.title: New: Resolution 583 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH SUSTAINABILITY PARTNERS SUBSIDIARY HAWAIʻI ISLAND EV, LLC, TO REPLACE AND INSTALL ADDITIONAL ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a ten-year lease agreement with an approximate monthly cost of $5,717, to replace inoperable and aging vehicle charging stations and install four additional charging stations at the West Hawaiʻi Civic Center, the Aupuni Center, and the County Building.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 583-24, Draft 2 & FC-183 - 9/4/24
